idiom_name: hand-written class implementing the repository interface over Dictionary<TKey,TValue>
implementation_notes: Write a test-only class that implements the collaborator interface with a Dictionary (or ConcurrentDictionary) as its store, so writes made by the system under test are visible to later reads - the working behaviour a fake needs. Microsoft Fakes generates stubs and shims and libraries such as Moq or NSubstitute produce mocks, so none of them is the fake route; for the database case an in-memory provider (for example EF Core's InMemory provider) is a ready-made fake of that specific collaborator. Keep the class in the test project so it can never ship, and re-create it per test.
pitfalls: Dictionary<TKey,TValue> is not thread-safe, and a fake kept in a static field or a shared collection fixture leaks writes between tests - re-create it per test.
A fake that returns null or default where the real repository throws (or the reverse) silently rewrites the error path the test is supposed to exercise.
Async members must keep the asynchronous shape (return real Tasks); a fake that blocks synchronously hides the concurrency behaviour under test.
